name: copilot-license-server
description: Licence server for the Copilot desktop app (Cloudflare Worker + D1).

scripts.db:init:local: wrangler d1 execute copilot-license-test --env test --local --file schema.sql
scripts.db:init:test: wrangler d1 execute copilot-license-test --env test --remote --file schema.sql
scripts.db:init:production: wrangler d1 execute copilot-license --env production --remote --file schema.sql
scripts.db:migrate:test: wrangler d1 execute copilot-license-test --env test --remote --file migrations/0003_names.sql
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 execute copilot-license --env production --remote --file migrations/0002_downloads.sql && wrangler d1 execute copilot-license --env production --remote --file migrations/0003_names.sql
